name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Partner Toss
cardText:
Medicine Ball Chest Press Partner Toss
Beginner
1
Stand tall, partner tosses medicine ball to chest.
2
Catch ball and press it back to partner. Repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Pushup
cardText:
Medicine Ball Pushup
Intermediate
1
Place hands on medicine ball, in push-up position.
2
Perform push-up, maintaining proper form.

name: Medicine Ball Walkover Pushup
cardText:
Medicine Ball Walkover Pushup
Intermediate
1
Place one hand on medicine ball, other on ground.
2
Perform push-up, walking hands to switch positions.
